23 reasons I love my Bubbi

💗

some are romantic. some are silly. all of them are very you.

01

your voice

There is just something about hearing you that makes me happy.

02

Your laugh makes me want to laugh even when I wasn't laughing in the first place.

03

your yappies

I could listen to you yap for ages and somehow still want more.

04

the way you mock me

You somehow manage to make being bullied by you adorable. 😭

05

The fact that you STILL find 67 funny is honestly one of my favourite things.

06

You have such a sweet heart, Bubbi.

08

your sleepy voice

10

11

I love seeing you get genuinely excited about something.

12

your stupid jokes

Even the terrible ones. Especially the terrible ones.

13

how you listen to my yapping

Thank you for surviving all my random stories. 😭

14

I genuinely like hearing about your day and all your little work stories.

15

You falling asleep while I yap is one of my favourite little routines.

16

17

I love the silly version of you that comes out when we're together.

18

Even with all those kilometres between us, you still feel close.

19

“Smile bigger.” Then “show teeth.” And suddenly I am actually smiling. 😭

20

That tiny sentence has way too much power over me.

21

Because obviously every obvious statement needs a DUHHHH at the end.

From poop analogies to “shit tzu,” somehow our conversations always become chaos.

23

because you're you

At the end of the day, I just love you for being my Bubbi. ♡

♡ for my hammiewammie boy ♡

Happy 23rd birthday, Bubbi!

I'm really so lucky to have met such a sweet, caring, amazing guy. Out of all the random people I could have met, somehow I met you — the boy who said “no no no French please” after I said bonjour. 😭

I love all our little things: our midnight yap sessions, our stupid jokes, the way you make me smile, the way you listen to me, and all the completely ridiculous conversations that somehow become memories I never want to forget.

I love you so much, Bazil. My hammiewammie boy is turning 23 yayyy. I hope you know how special you are to me, even when there are kilometres between us.

Happy birthday, my Bubbi. ♡

love,
Arpi 🎀

P.S. DUHHHH you thought that was all? 😭
